from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u049/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p=base/'task-f0cd9dc5.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    height, width = len(out), len(out[0])
    occupied = [any(v != 0 for v in row) for row in out]
    for r in range(1, height - 1):
        if not occupied[r] and occupied[r - 1] and occupied[r + 1]:
            out[r] = [3] * width
            break
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_f0cd9dc5', p)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
demo=[[0]*10 for _ in range(10)]
for r in (2,3,5,6):
    for c in (2,5): demo[r][c]=2
for c in range(3,5):
    demo[2][c]=demo[6][c]=2
# expected demonstration output: input with row 4 filled 3
expected=[row[:] for row in demo]; expected[4]=[3]*10
print('demo matches:', mod.transform(demo)==expected)
test=[[0]*10 for _ in range(10)]
for r in (1,2,3,5):
    for c in range(1,5): test[r][c]=2
ans=mod.transform(test)
print(ans)
print('program:', p)
